speaker: Thabo Lebethoa
title: Jesus Christ Is the Light and Life of the World
summary: Elder Lebethoa teaches that Jesus Christ is the light and life of the world, and that whatever our struggles, the answer is always Him. He tells how his name and his wife's name together mean “eternal joy,” how the Savior's words against contention in 3 Nephi helped him know how to resolve their first serious argument as newlyweds, and how a man reading the Book of Mormon buried a new tin of coffee in his garden. He asks us to build faith through consistent scripture study and prayer and to ponder what we need to change, promising that through Christ today can be a new day and tomorrow a better day.
